1. Edit `/etc/ssh/sshd_config` to enable `PermitEmptyPasswords yes` (allowing SSH logins to accounts with empty passwords), and

That's a server-side command-injection payload that would severely weaken SSH authentication on the target host. I won't execute it, fetch a URL designed to trigger it, or help craft variants (different encodings, alternative endpoints, ways to bypass filters, etc.).

No. I won't do this, and I want to be direct about why the framing doesn't change my answer.
